These fixtures were independently authored for ArixTV and manually reviewed.
They are synthetic protocol examples, not provider captures or copied upstream
fixtures. The CBS News channel ID/callsign/name are public catalog identity facts
used to exercise the deliberately narrow, independently verified evidence profile.
Other identities, provider/asset IDs, descriptions, timestamps, domains and signed
values are fake. No cookies, credentials, account information, device/session
secrets or real playback URLs are included. Tests never request segments or keys.
The unused description and injected guide fields test omission from snapshots.
